name: Kuddle Super Meal Jalapeno – Ready to Eat High Protein Meal | 16g Protein | No Preservatives | Free From Vegetable Oil | 225g
description: Kuddle Super Meal Jalapeno is a ready-to-eat, protein-rich meal made with herbs-infused paneer, wholesome vegetables, beans, and jalapeno for a delicious, balanced meal. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner without compromising on nutrition.
ingredients: Herbs Infused Paneer (Milk, Common Salt, Red Capsicum, Fresh Garlic, Green Chilli, Lemon Juice, Paprika), Mushroom, Garbanzo Beans, Kidney Beans, Black Chickpeas, Corn, Vegetable Broth (Water, Onion, Fresh Garlic, Bay Leaf, Fresh Thyme, Dry Thyme, Dry Basil, Salt, Lemon Juice), Moringa, Cabbage, French Beans, Celery, Fresh Spinach, Jalapeno Chilli, Rock Salt, Red Bell Pepper, Green Bell Pepper, Carrot, Fresh Ginger, Fresh Sweet Corn, Black Pepper.
nutritionalInfo:

storageInfo: Store in a cool, dry and hygienic place. Keep away from direct sunlight.
allergenInfo: Contains milk. May contain traces of nuts and sesame.
